import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] input = read(scanner);
        int h = input[0];
        int n = input[1];
        n = n - 1;
        String binaryRep = Integer.toBinaryString(n);
        binaryRep = "0".repeat(h - binaryRep.length()) + binaryRep;

        StringBuilder transformed = new StringBuilder();
        for (int idx = 0; idx < h; idx++) {
            if (idx > 0 && binaryRep.charAt(idx - 1) == '0') {
                transformed.append(binaryRep.charAt(idx) == '0' ? '1' : '0');
            } else {
                transformed.append(binaryRep.charAt(idx));
            }
        }

        long totalValue = 0;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < h; idx++) {
            totalValue += 1;
            if (transformed.charAt(idx) == '1') {
                totalValue += Math.pow(2, h - idx) - 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalValue);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static int[] read(Scanner scanner) {
        String dataInput = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        String[] parts = dataInput.split("\\s+");
        int[] result = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            result[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return result;
    }
}
